note: Three pars on the floor and nothing else. Renjith's rig, 9 Sept: if a song cannot communicate its meaning through three lamps, no number of fixtures will fix that -- it will only hide it. A 101-fixture rig can carry a bad map on spectacle. This one cannot carry anything. Every failure here is legible, because a frame is three numbers.

limits.note: No movers, so no pan/tilt budget. A par that cannot move has to say everything with level and colour, which is the point of this rig.
